steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Greeks worshipped the twelve Olympian gods, each with specific domains: Zeus (king of gods), Hera (marriage), Athena (wisdom), Apollo (prophecy/music), Poseidon (sea), Ares (war), Aphrodite (love), etc.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Sacrifice (thusia) was the central act of Greek worship: animal sacrifices were offered at temples and altars, with the gods receiving the bones and fat while worshippers ate the meat

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Oracles, especially Delphi (sacred to Apollo), provided divine guidance on major decisions: war, colonisation, politics

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Pan-Hellenic festivals (Olympic, Pythian, Nemean, Isthmian Games) brought Greeks together in celebration and athletic competition
